unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #692 proposing Nano (XNO) as a feeless per-call settlement rail beside treg Stripe pass-through billing. The live Vend extract endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/extract, x402 manifest at extract.paypercall.dev/.well-known/x402, 0.0001 XNO per call, no signup, 5 trials/day) is a real paid service an agent can verify now. Asked whether treg exposes a pluggable settlement interface or if per-call billing is fully Stripe-mediated.
